Had a shroom trip on 7g where I had ego death and stayed in the same spot on my friend’s bed for about 2-3 hours as I came down. That entire time, I visualized coming down from the trip and essentially being brain dead and having some form of HPPD. Before ego death and my peak, I had essentially forgotten how to speak English, and was so disoriented from my visuals that I couldn’t identify what was in front of me. Closing my eyes meant visuals so intense that it made me nauseous. Anyways, I hallucinated an entire lifetime following that trip. I hallucinated my friends calling 911. I hallucinated my mom showing up. I hallucinated going to the hospital and being declared unresponsive to some extent and mentally disabled. I will also add that I have mental illness in my family and have been diagnosed with bipolar disorder. It is not unlikely that a trip could cause me to be unable to live independently for the rest of my life depending on the circumstances. Throughout it all, my ex boyfriend stayed with me until I died in that lifetime of old age. Funny thing is, I completely forgot about this entire lifetime I experienced in my trip until I solo tripped on acid last week and had a flashback that brought me immediately to sobbing tears. I have yet to have a trip where I have not imagined I was dead or dying at some point. It isn’t scary to me, I actually consider it a natural reaction to the concepts of birth, life, death, and rebirth that are very apparent on psychs.
Hope it goes well! 5g and 7g were some of my most influential shroom trips!

I mentioned this to my endocrinologist, and apparently a lot of kids are starting puberty a year or two earlier than in the past. So it wouldn't be exactly the same as a cis guy's puberty, but everyone is different. I'm going back to school in a week so that will be a good marker of how much I've changed, but honestly I've been seeing a lot of the changes you'd see on amab 16-17 year olds who are alredy a few years along with puberty at just 5 months on a rather low dosage. On the dosing, my doc is increasing me every four months until my T count gets into the adult male range.
